objective: Prepare a defensible taxonomy study without creating human labels or treating the exposed Lane-X pilot as independent validation.

limitations: The comparison was one repository author versus AI suggestions, not inter-human agreement.
The author saw AI-written summaries and received an ordered stop-at-first-match instruction absent from protocol v0.2.0.
The seed tracker is secondary aggregation; linked primary records were not opened for that corpus.
Every read Lane-X family remains exposed and cannot become held out by relabeling.

unit.primary_sampling_unit: one canonical finding per conservative family
unit.finding_definition: one root cause, affected producer-to-consumer boundary, and repair lineage
unit.split_rule: split only independent missing relations that require independent repairs
unit.merge_rule: merge reports that share root cause, boundary, and repair lineage; retain aliases and manifestations

relevance.include: Primary evidence supports a sound accepted relation or configuration, its decoding/consumer interpretation, and a possible committed incompatible protected effect or undischarged required obligation under an independently stated policy.
relevance.exclude: Positive evidence establishes an out-of-scope cryptographic/setup/privacy-only issue, a pure producer or pure consumer bug without a proof-to-execution disagreement, or availability/DoS only with no accepted transition and no committed incompatible effect or undischarged obligation.
relevance.unresolved: The boundary, policy, accepted-proof feasibility, consumer effect, or primary evidence is missing, conflicting, or too weak to decide inclusion.
relevance.missing_primary_evidence: UNRESOLVED, never EXCLUDE and never inferred from an aggregator summary
relevance.no_safety_inference: A reverted or unavailable path is not a committed effect, but missing feasibility evidence remains unresolved rather than safe.

cause_rules: Label the evidenced root boundary mechanism, not downstream effects or manifestations.
Use multiple causes only for distinct evidenced mechanisms; co-occurrence or alternate wording is insufficient.
A specific mapping, representation, activation, context, verification-configuration, occurrence, or transformation label takes precedence over C_RELATION_GAP for the same omitted relation.
C_RELATION_GAP is reserved for an omitted dependency not fully described by a more specific code.
A non-binary or out-of-range selector is C_REPRESENTATION; a separately misbound count, prefix, tag, padding, length, or activation relation is C_ACTIVATION_EXTENT.
A wrong forwarded identity/order/slice is C_FIELD_MAPPING; do not add it merely because a representation defect later selects a wrong value.
Replay or duplication is a consequence unless the boundary itself loses multiplicity, identity, or single-use accounting.
C_OTHER_BINDING requires a mechanism description and codebook-review flag.
consequence_rules: Every complete included finding marks K_AUTHORIZATION, K_COVERAGE, or both present.
Secondary consequence codes describe the committed effect or undischarged obligation and never substitute for the top-level property.
Severity, privacy, financial loss, and liveness are source claims outside this axis.
A reverted effect is absent; uncertain reachability or proof feasibility remains uncertain.
role_rules: Record minimum sufficient attacker roles, not every actor in the system.
Use attack-path notes to distinguish conjunctive roles from alternatives.
Unsupported or unevidenced capability is uncertain, not absent.

future_corpus.frame: Complete the frozen v0.2.0 source-class traversal or a prospectively amended frame; seed-only or application-name searches cannot be the primary frame.
future_corpus.eligible_units: Canonical findings with primary-evidence packets and family/exposure provenance.
future_corpus.primary_agreement_sample: At most one finding per conservative family, selected without seeing labels and stratified prospectively by source class and pre-annotation relevance uncertainty, not by a desired mechanism distribution.
future_corpus.calibration: A separate exposed calibration set may be discussed and is never scored.
future_corpus.freshness: Reliability items must be fresh to both raters; re-rating the 17 exposed pilot items is reported only as an exposed-pilot study.
future_corpus.stopping: Freeze the frame, sample size, draw, replacements, and inaccessible-item handling before ratings; never stop after a desired coefficient or category count.
future_corpus.claim_limit: No ecosystem prevalence or incidence estimate follows from this purposive public-disclosure frame.

annotation.raters: exactly two independent humans for the primary round
annotation.adjudicator: one distinct human after original ratings and agreement output are sealed
packet_blinding: no E-level validation result unless it is inseparable from the frozen primary disclosure
annotation.independence: Raters work separately and disclose actual prior exposure per family.
annotation.disagreement: Retain both original ratings; adjudication appends a cited resolution and never overwrites them.
annotation.codebook_change: Any change after ratings are unsealed increments the version and makes the affected round developmental, not confirmatory.

agreement.primary_multilabel_metric: Cohen kappa separately for each binary category
agreement.secondary: raw exact-set agreement per axis for complete pairs only
agreement.missingness: uncertain, unassessed, omitted, and null are missing rather than absent
agreement.undefined: return null with a reason when there are no comparable pairs or no chance variance
agreement.uncertainty: No interval is computed in preparation. A family-cluster interval design and adequacy rule must be frozen before ratings are unsealed.
agreement.prohibited: Do not choose among kappa, alpha, AC1, or another coefficient after seeing which is favorable; do not pool labels into one macro score.

human_dependencies: A custodian completes and freezes the future sampling frame and exposure-safe draw.
Two humans with disclosed prior exposure independently annotate fresh packets.
A third human adjudicates only after original ratings and agreement are sealed.
Authors inspect the codebook, packets, script, labels, and claims before publication.
claim_limits: This preparation contains no new human labels, judgments, predictions, or agreement result.
The exposed pilot refines the codebook but cannot validate it or establish inter-rater reliability.
Agreement measures reproducibility, not truth, taxonomy validity, security, or prevalence.
AI systems are not raters, adjudicators, or independent reviewers.
